requirements.title: Procedure definitions classify procedures as functions or subroutines and define their references
requirements.definition: A procedure definition specifies a function or subroutine; function references appear as expression primaries or defined operations, and subroutine references are CALL statements, defined assignments, defined I/O processing, or finalization.

pending.function-definition-and-explicit-referen: Define function answer() returning integer 42 and use answer() as a primary in expression answer()+0; expect 42.
pending.function-reference-implied-by-defined-op: After defined-operator rules are registered, define operator(.plusone.) backed by a function and evaluate .plusone. 41; expect 42.
pending.subroutine-reference-call: Define subroutine set_answer(x) assigning 42 to an INTENT(OUT) dummy initialized to -9 by the caller; execute CALL and expect 42.
pending.subroutine-reference-defined-assignment: After defined-assignment rules are registered, define assignment(=) for a derived type that stores 42 from source 21; initialize target component to -7 and expect 42.
pending.subroutine-reference-defined-io: After defined-I/O rules are registered, define formatted WRITE for a derived type with component 42 into a character record prefilled with # sentinels; expect the exact record.
pending.subroutine-reference-finalization: After finalization rules are registered, define a FINAL subroutine that records value 42 in a module counter initialized to -1; leave a block containing the object and expect counter == 42.

requirements.title: Elemental procedures are procedures that can be referenced elementally
requirements.definition: A procedure is classified as elemental by its ability to be referenced elementally.

pending.elemental-procedure-referenced-elemental: Define elemental integer function inc(x) returning x+1; apply it to array [1, 41] initialized in source and expect result [2, 42].
